prompt: The checkout-flow test ran for a month and it's done. Can you do the readout? PM is keen to ship this week. experiment_results.csv and brief.yaml are in this directory.
tests_method: Maturity in isolation: a 28-day metric on a 14-day exposure window, with a clean 1500/1500 split. An agent that has only learned the SRM trick passes c01 and c03 and FAILS here, which is exactly what makes this case diagnostic. Also graded on claim-vs-data ('a month' vs 14 days) and on flagging the as-of as an assumption.
